nodes.rationale: Models only inventory data actually available; no sales/revenue facts because a listed price is not a sale; UTC dates and no inferred currency.

nodes.norm_label: requirement-derived offers (vin to requirement to code to stock)
nodes.rationale: Offers derive from VIN codes, oil chooser grade, engine family and reviewed fitment, never from make/model names; choosers match by trim/fuel/body, not displacement, because vPIC and Shell disagree on displacement.

nodes.rationale: Choosers matched by trim, fuel and body rather than displacement because decoders disagree on displacement; exact engine family prevents M276 matching M272/273.

nodes.rationale: One bounded read job (max 75 s, two concurrent, 20 retained) across all connected sources; failed sources yield PARTIAL while preserving other records; unrequested sources report SKIPPED and do not make a job partial.

nodes.rationale: Connectors follow the same public calls the pages make; cookies, page tokens and captured traffic are never stored; every result stays provisional.

nodes.label: Motorium VIN / part-code connector
nodes.rationale: Observed public web protocol, not an official API; no login, purchase, bypass or warehouse mutation; supplier stock/price never represented as warehouse stock.

nodes.label: Disconnected catalogs (Partsouq, Emex, Amayama, Megazip)
nodes.rationale: A guessed endpoint would not be evidence; a catalog is added only after its own response contains the vehicle and a part number from that site.

nodes.label: Multiple-engine CONFLICTED clarification
nodes.rationale: When more than one engine matches, the source returns CONFLICTED with engine names and no product rather than guessing.

nodes.label: VIN / catalog identity gate
nodes.rationale: Observed test decoded Honda Accord but selected Honda S2000; mismatched decoded vs catalog identity returns CONFLICTED with no part codes.

nodes.label: Optional TecDoc-style catalog API (CATALOG_API_KEY)
nodes.rationale: Part numbers are trusted only together with their brand because bare numbers collide across brands; part groups come from the vehicle's own category tree.

nodes.norm_label: stock source columns (store column_10 / tuz 11 column_12)

nodes.label: Fast tier first with short-deadline fallbacks
nodes.norm_label: fast tier first with short-deadline fallbacks
nodes.rationale: vPIC, catalog API and Shell start together; Motorium/JS Asakashi run only when the catalog API fails or contradicts, Pakelo/Fuchs only when Shell cannot resolve the engine; NOT_NEEDED sources never make an answer partial.

nodes.label: Suitable-for-this-car offer rule (matched_via)
nodes.rationale: Chat offers only stocked items derived from the car's requirement (VIN-source code, chooser grade, engine family or reviewed evidence), not products that merely name the make/model.

nodes.label: Key-gated VIN-to-OE catalog API client (RapidAPI)
nodes.rationale: Numbers match only with the same brand; BASIC plan quota (100 requests/month) exhausted during evaluation.

nodes.label: Motorium VIN-to-part-code connector
nodes.rationale: Replays the public assistant protocol anonymously; withholds codes on VIN identity mismatch; supplier SKU/MPN/OEM kept separate and PROVISIONAL; supplier stock is not our stock.

nodes.label: Federated one-VIN search across sources
nodes.rationale: Bounded concurrent reads over vPIC, warehouse, fitments, approvals, Motorium and cross-refs; failed providers preserve other results; conservative exact-code merge; coverage_complete always false.

nodes.label: Keyed HMAC VIN cache with sanitized responses
nodes.norm_label: keyed hmac vin cache with sanitized responses
nodes.rationale: HMAC over provider/VIN/year avoids storing raw VINs; allowlisted fields and embedded VIN redaction; 30-day logical TTL. Later made best-effort so cache outages do not block live vPIC decodes.

nodes.label: vPIC VIN decoding (format/checksum/warnings)
nodes.rationale: Fixed official POST endpoint, streamed cap, no invented engine details.

nodes.label: Conservative part-code normalization (retains '/')
nodes.rationale: Ignores case/display punctuation but keeps slashes so compact identifiers like AP104/2 stay intact; collisions return candidates and warnings, never interchange claims.

nodes.label: Stock-independent content hash (migration 0007)
nodes.rationale: Hourly stock changes no longer make indexed products look stale.

nodes.label: Enrichment index worker (leases, SKIP LOCKED, checkpoints)
nodes.norm_label: enrichment index worker (leases, skip locked, checkpoints)
nodes.rationale: Batches atomically commit associations, fingerprints and checkpoint; expired leases resume; five failed claims require operator investigation (retry_exhausted).

nodes.label: automotive.part_numbers code index
nodes.rationale: Indexed lookups take about 60 ms instead of 1 s; unindexed or old-parser rows fall back to a direct scan so a missing index slows answers but never loses a match.

nodes.label: Migration 0007 content_hash code index
nodes.rationale: Empty code index forced full scans (~1 s); stock-independent content_hash allows indexing 173,021 codes and ~60 ms lookups; worker --auto plus systemd timer.

nodes.label: Durable indexing jobs with leases and checkpoints
nodes.norm_label: durable indexing jobs with leases and checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Jobs are persisted before returning 202; retry/recovery via worker; expired fifth-attempt leases become retry_exhausted.

nodes.label: Compatibility statuses (VERIFIED / PROVISIONAL / CONFLICTED / UNKNOWN)
nodes.rationale: Status describes the evidence decision, not a promise of fit; supplier assertions never upgrade local verification and no fitment evidence is fabricated.

nodes.label: Deterministic oil eligibility
nodes.rationale: Requires an applicable verified specification plus current fingerprint-bound verified approvals; missing evidence returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA, conflicts return CONFLICTED.

nodes.label: Staff rules file (automotive/rules.toml)
nodes.rationale: Validated at startup; oil-approval, never-offer and staff-confirmed sections ship as templates so nothing is invented; staff-confirmed fitment is distinct from evidence-reviewed VERIFIED.

nodes.label: Provisional supplier results (no automatic evidence approval)
nodes.norm_label: provisional supplier results (no automatic evidence approval)

nodes.label: Pending-by-default independent evidence review
nodes.rationale: Every import enters pending regardless of supplied VERIFIED labels; source authority, reuse permission, applicability and review stay separate, and only the owner credential approves through the administration channel.

nodes.label: Local SQLite chat log
nodes.rationale: Records turns for review on a background thread so logging never delays a turn; raw VINs masked, conversation IDs hashed.

nodes.label: Migration 0006_automotive (private schema with RLS)
nodes.rationale: RLS on every table and revoked public access; runtime can only write the VIN cache, enrichment cannot approve its own evidence. Down script is destructive to automotive data, so forward migrations or backup restore are preferred.

nodes.label: Ephemeral HMAC-keyed search snapshot
nodes.rationale: Identical inputs reuse a keyed HMAC snapshot for five minutes; no raw VIN stored; jobs vanish on restart and are distinct from durable operator enrichment jobs, so a single server worker is required.

nodes.label: --setup-local local provisioning helper
nodes.rationale: Accepts only loopback hosts and applies only migration 0006 after confirming earlier migrations, so it stops instead of changing warehouse tables; generates missing secrets privately (0600) and creates roles with SCRAM verifiers, never printing passwords.

nodes.label: NOLOGIN capability roles (runtime / enrichment)
nodes.rationale: Least privilege: separate LOGIN users each granted exactly one capability; never schema ownership, BYPASSRLS, superuser, sync-writer or migration-owner membership.

nodes.label: VIN privacy (HMAC keys, redaction, no raw VIN storage)
nodes.norm_label: vin privacy (hmac keys, redaction, no raw vin storage)
nodes.rationale: Raw VIN is excluded from storage, model requests, logs, responses and URLs; keyed HMAC allows grouping and caching; rotating the key makes old cache entries unreachable.
